Two offenders: `scripts/order_reminder.py` and `scripts/nightly_summary.py` both built an `EmailMessage` and called `smtplib.SMTP` directly. Both now call `send("<job>", "see attached")` from `notify.py`, with the same subject, body, sender and recipient as before.

`smtplib` now appears only in `scripts/notify.py`. The other mail senders (`disk_alert.py`, `report_low_stock.py`, `audit_export.py`) already used the helper.

I didn't run the two scripts, since that would send real mail through localhost:25. The test suite has 2 failures out of 4, both in `tests/test_inventory.py` (`test_low_stock_includes_threshold`, `test_merge_sums_repeats`). They exercise inventory logic in `app/`, which I didn't touch, and no test covers the scripts. I left them alone.

The chisle plugin's statusline badge isn't configured. Say so if you want me to add it to `settings.json`.
